scope: three independently authored candidate-bound GLB levels, strict semantic/envelope validation, LOD2 POSITION-derived gameplay-only AABB sidecars, optional LOD0 rigid animation binding and isolated Three.js consumer validation
limitations: This is an authored three-level LOD set structural verifier, not a Runtime or Worker automatic mesh simplifier.

The three levels are separate candidate-bound GLBs. The slice verifies stable Part, source-node and MaterialZone sets, exact Part-to-MaterialZone mapping, strict ArtifactReadback@2, progressive triangle counts and bounded envelopes; it does not prove all three were algorithmically derived from one source mesh.
The optional rigid animation is bound to LOD0 only. LOD1 and LOD2 animation artifacts are not materialized or claimed.
The collision proxies are conservative local-space AABB boxes for gameplay asset assembly only. They are not hitboxes, rigid-body physics, damage, ballistics or real-world collision truth.
Three.js GLTFLoader and AnimationMixer consumer validation passed, but Unity, Unreal and Godot editor/importer round-trips remain NOT_RUN.
No candidate was confirmed and no user-facing external file export was performed.
Structural delivery and consumer compatibility do not prove visual likeness, commercial-game art quality, performance budgets or HQ360.
